spec_match.rationale: Reads the exact surfaces the spec names — the static supportsReliableOnly on the constructor and the per-session reliability attribute — and mirrors the normative lifecycle ([[Reliability]] = "pending" at construction, unchanged by a failed establishment).

interactive.rationale: A real new WebTransport() attempt is opened on demand and the attribute is sampled at construction, at ready rejection, and after closed settles, into a timestamped table plus live-region summary.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a static read plus a timestamped lifecycle timeline; the page delivers exactly those two panels.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers attribute-missing (pre-158 build), constructor-throw, established (unexpected here), failed-establishment branches, and distinguishes network refusal from reliability rejection in the copy.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5094058497277952 and the spec's reliability section on the page and the feature index.

conformance.rationale: New 9-assertion feature suite checks prototype placement, readonly accessor shape, initial "pending", enum vocabulary, static placement + boolean type, strict-write TypeError, and an honest manual assertion for the establishment transition; on this container's Chromium 141 it executes 1 pass / 7 fail / 1 blocked.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): button driven on desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740, zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow, screenshots read on both classes; the timeline showed the honest attribute-missing branch with a real WebTransportError failure. Partial, not pass: the 158+ supported path (pending → attribute present) could not be executed on this build, including behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts wt-reliability-initial-pending, wt-reliability-stays-pending-on-failure, wt-reliability-static-read, and an explicit fallback assert; ready/closed promises are claimed so no unhandled rejections reach the console.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons set background and color together; pending/missing value colors (accent-blue, accent-rose) sit on bg-paper at AA contrast.

accessibility.rationale: Native button, data table with caption and th scope, single polite live region per surface, visible focus from the shared stylesheet, definition list for the static read collapses to one column at narrow widths.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: no horizontal overflow (0px both), 44px control targets, tables wrap via overflow-wrap, screenshots verified on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Verify the supported path on a Chrome 158+ build
openQuestions.detail: This container's Chromium 141 predates WebTransportReliability even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, so only the honest attribute-missing branch ran in the browser. On a 158+ or flag-enabled build, verify the timeline reads "pending" at all three sample points against the dead endpoint and the conformance route reaches 8/9 with only the manual establishment-transition assertion blocked.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: One polite live region per changing surface; announce meaningful results, not interstitial noise; keep labels programmatic.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The timeline summary is a single aria-live=polite output written once per attempt with the final diagnosis; the static verdict is static-rendered text, not a live region; all controls are native buttons.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with thead/th scope inside an overflow wrapper; keep header-cell relationships rather than div soup.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The sample table uses caption + th scope=col in a .table-wrap with overflow-x:auto and overflow-wrap:anywhere cells; verified 0px page-level overflow at 360px.

summary: Static supportsReliableOnly read plus a real-session reliability timeline sampled at construction/failure/close. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment) on Chromium 141: honest attribute-missing branch, real WebTransportError connection failure, clean console and network, 0px overflow both classes.
